# lxr-spirits — Immersive Spirit Guide Ritual System

Bring a deeper mystical layer to your RedM roleplay server. lxr-spirits lets players undergo a cinematic ancestral ritual and discover a persistent spirit animal such as Wolf, Eagle, Bear, Cougar, Fox, or Raven.

## Includes

- Cinematic ritual flow
- Spirit animal reveal UI
- Configurable sacred locations
- Persistent SQL result storage
- Optional required ritual item
- Multi-framework bridge
- English + Georgian locales
- Tebex escrow-friendly structure

Built for serious roleplay servers that want atmosphere, identity, lore, and player-driven spiritual storytelling.
